chunks: And Safwan narrated from Yazid ibn Khalifah, who said:

Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام) saw me circumambulating around the Ka'bah while I was wearing a burṭulah, so he said: “After this, you circumambulate around the Ka'bah while wearing a burṭulah? Do not wear it around the Ka'bah, for it is from the attire of the Jews.”

key_terms.أَطُوفُ: I perform tawaf; I circumambulate in worship around the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the sacred House around which tawaf is performed
key_terms.بُرْطُلَةٌ: a burṭulah, a particular item of dress or footwear mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.زِيِّ: attire, appearance, or distinctive mode of dress

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wear a burṭulah while performing tawaf around the Ka'bah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام forbade wearing a burṭulah while performing tawaf around the Ka'bah. The narration indicates a ruling tied to the sanctity of worship and avoidance of attire identified with the Jews in that setting.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2839 - Safwan narrated from Yazid ibn Khalifa, who said:

Abu Abdullah (as) saw me circumambulating the Ka'bah while wearing a burṭula (a type of footwear), and Imam (as) said: "After this, you circumambulate the Ka'bah while wearing a burṭula? Do not wear it while circumambulating the Ka'bah, for it is from the attire of the Jews."
